result.instructions: Tools for 360Learning, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which learners are enrolled in our onboarding path, and how far have they got?"; "List the courses we published this month and who wrote them."; "Add Maria to the Sales group as a learner.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes 360Learning data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run 360learning_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run 360learning_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run 360learning_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. 360learning_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: 360learning_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users in the platform. Filter by email, username or status. Needs scope users:read. GET /api/v2/users.

mail.description: Only the user with this email address.

username.description: Only the user with this username.

next.description: next_page_token from the previous call. When set, the other filters are ignored (the server keeps them).

tools.name: 360learning_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one user by id, with profile, status and custom fields. Needs scope users:read. GET /api/v2/users/{userId}.

tools.name: 360learning_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List all groups (teams) in the platform. Needs scope groups:read. GET /api/v2/groups.

next.description: next_page_token from the previous call. When set, the other filters are ignored (the server keeps them).

tools.name: 360learning_get_group
tools.title: Get a group
tools.description: Get one group by id. Needs scope groups:read. GET /api/v2/groups/{groupId}.

tools.name: 360learning_list_group_members
tools.title: List group members
tools.description: List the users and roles (admin, coach, learner, ...) in one group. Needs scope groups:read. GET /api/v2/groups/{groupId}/roles.

next.description: next_page_token from the previous call. When set, the other filters are ignored (the server keeps them).

tools.name: 360learning_add_user_role_to_group
tools.title: Add a user role to a group
tools.description: Give a user a role in a group (for example learner or coach). Adding a role the user already has changes nothing. Needs scope groups:write. POST /api/v2/groups/{groupId}/{role}/{userId}.

annotations.title: Add a user role to a group

tools.name: 360learning_remove_user_role_from_group
tools.title: Remove a user role from a group
tools.description: Remove a role from a user in a group. The user loses the access the role gives. Needs scope groups:write. DELETE /api/v2/groups/{groupId}/{role}/{userId}.

annotations.title: Remove a user role from a group
